notes.en:
Each unit publishes its own port and its own tailnet name; the addresses are
printed at the end of the install.

### Update

Each unit carries its own tag — the table above lists them. Nothing updates
on its own; the command above applies whatever the repository pins.
notes.pt:
Cada unit publica a própria porta e o próprio nome na tailnet; os endereços
saem no fim da instalação.

### Atualizar

Cada unit tem a própria tag — a tabela acima lista todas. Nada atualiza
sozinho; o comando acima aplica o que o repositório pinou.

.env.example.note: The stack has two EnvironmentFile= entries, so the generic `.env.example` has to say which of the two it is. media-stack-gluetun.env.example matches on its own, because its name already lines up with the destination.

MEDIA_DATA_DIR.note: The one path decision in this stack: the root the media lives under, read by every unit through Volume=${MEDIA_DATA_DIR}. It is a variable of the systemd --user manager, not of an .env, because Quadlet expands Volume= there (rule 19). The install asks for it when it is unset, with this one Enter away.

backup.note: Jellyfin rebuilds its cache (images, transcodes) on its own.

upstream.note: The image is still published as qmcgaw/gluetun; the repository moved from qdm12/gluetun to passteque/gluetun, and the old name only redirects.
